description: This file defines a Roslyn analyzer for C# code, specifically an analyzer that checks for classes, structs, records, and record structs that are serializable but lack a custom serializer attribute. It registers syntax node actions to analyze relevant type declarations and reports diagnostics when necessary.

classes.name: GenerateGenerateSerializerAttributeAnalyzer
classes.description: A DiagnosticAnalyzer that inspects C# code for serializable types missing a serializer attribute and reports diagnostics accordingly.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Configures analysis context, enabling concurrent execution, analyzing generated code, and registering syntax node actions for relevant declaration types.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Checks class, struct, record, or record struct declarations for the presence of serializable attributes and reports diagnostics if the serializer attribute is missing.
